status: PREREGISTERED — design frozen before any validation evaluation
hypothesis: V1's ELO/EPA ratings update too crudely as teams evolve within a season. A strictly-pregame dynamic offensive/defensive strength representation with weekly updating and recency weighting may capture evolving team strength better than V1's ensemble.
frozen_upstream: V1 model code and scripts 01-17 unmodified

data_scope.games: all 2227 games in data/experiments/games_features.parquet (2018-2025, REG + playoffs)
data_scope.vault: 2023-2025 — never touched unless full gate passes

rating_representation.off: team offensive strength: expected points scored above league average vs a league-average defense (0 = average)
rating_representation.def: team defensive strength: expected points allowed above league average vs a league-average offense (0 = average; higher = worse defense)
rating_representation.initialization: off=0, def=0 for all 32 teams at start of 2018 season
rating_representation.scope_decision: total offense/defense only — NO pass/rush subcomponent split (preregistered; one conceptual change)

update_equations.margin_formula: candidate_margin = pred_home_pts - pred_away_pts = off[home] - off[away] + def[away] - def[home] + Hf
update_equations.weekly_batch_update: all games of week W are predicted with pre-week-W ratings; updates applied after the week
update_rule: e_h = home_score - pred_home_pts; e_a = away_score - pred_away_pts
update_equations.offseason_regression: before week 1 of each season 2019-2025: off *= (1 - r), def *= (1 - r), with r = 1/3 (matches V1 ELO convention; fixed, not tuned)
update_equations.post_fit_calibration: NONE — ratings are point-denominated by construction; calibration slope is a gate criterion, not a fitting target

frozen_parameter_rules.L_league_avg_pts: mean points per team-game over 2018-2020 (training only)
frozen_parameter_rules.K_update_rate: grid {0.03, 0.05, 0.08, 0.12, 0.18}; select K minimizing MAE on 2019-2020 training predictions (2018 excluded as burn-in); ties broken toward smaller K
frozen_parameter_rules.note: chosen values recorded in frozen_params.json by the build script BEFORE any validation metric is computed

prohibited: any feature derived from validation results
secondary_diagnostics: NOTE: diagnostics only — no filters or corrections built from them
error_correlation_analysis: correlation of prediction errors (actual - predicted) among V1, candidate, and market; tests whether candidate carries genuinely different information (criterion E)

preregistered_gate.A_material_v1_improvement: candidate validation MAE materially below V1 validation MAE
preregistered_gate.B_market_bar: candidate validation MAE <= market-only validation MAE - 0.15 (same bar as Experiment 002)
preregistered_gate.C_stability: improvement over market holds in 2021 AND 2022 individually (not one-season concentrated)
preregistered_gate.E_diversification: candidate error correlation with V1 error meaningfully below ~0.95 (not V1 plus noise)
preregistered_gate.consequence: ALL five required for vault. If ANY fails: CLOSE experiment, vault untouched, report null.

corrections_log.at: 2026-09-29, after first validation run, BEFORE any gate decision was reported
corrections_log.what: sign error in prediction equations: def terms were subtracted, contradicting the preregistered convention 'def = points allowed above average; higher = worse defense'
corrections_log.evidence: first run produced validation calibration slope -0.011 (ratings carried no signal); synthetic check: a team with def=+7 (terrible defense) was predicted to HOLD opponents to fewer points
corrections_log.fix: def terms now added in both prediction equations, matching the stated convention; update rule unchanged
corrections_log.preregistration_impact: none on design choices (K grid/rule, r, L/Hf rules, gate, baselines all unchanged); the corrected code is the first faithful implementation of the preregistered hypothesis. The buggy run's numbers are discarded as a non-test of the hypothesis.
